acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given income, expenses, and debt accounts are entered, when I view the Dashboard, then I see a "Cash Flow Health" card
Card displays Available Monthly Surplus in ZAR format (R X,XXX.XX)
Card displays status indicator: Green + "Breathing" if surplus > 10% of income, Amber + "Tight" if surplus is 0-10% of income, Red + "Drowning" if surplus is negative
Card displays Debt Consumption percentage (minimum payments / income × 100)
Card uses teal header (#0d9488) per UX spec
Status icon accompanies label (checkmark for Breathing, warning for Tight, X for Drowning)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System calculates and displays cash flow health: available monthly surplus (income - expenses - minimum debt payments), visual indicator (green/yellow/red), percentage of income consumed by debt

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use big.js for all monetary calculations. Cent-level accuracy guaranteed. String storage for precision preservation.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Dashboard components location: src/components/dashboard/ including HealthCard.tsx, ThreeNumbersGrid.tsx, DashboardSummary.tsx

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Primary: teal-600 (#0d9488). Semantic Colors: Success green-500 (#10b981), Warning amber-500 (#f59e0b), Error red-500 (#ef4444). Status indicators must use icon + color.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: HealthCard - Displays one of "Three Critical Numbers" with color-coded status. Props: title, value, status (green/yellow/red), trend.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Cash Flow Health Card - displays available surplus, status indicator (Breathing/Tight/Drowning), debt consumption percentage. Uses big.js for percentage calculations.

doc.title: Epic 3 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: CashFlowHealth interface: availableSurplus: Big, status: HealthStatus, statusLabel: string, debtConsumptionPercent: Big. Status determination: surplus > 10% = healthy, 0-10% = warning, negative = critical

constraints.constraint: All financial calculations must use big.js. Surplus and percentages calculated with Big type, then converted to string/number for display.
No Zustand needed for this story - data flows from Dexie via useFinancialSnapshot → useFinancialHealth → React components.
Color-coded status must include icon + color (never color alone for accessibility).
Card header must use teal-600 (#0d9488) background with white text.
Component must be placed in src/components/dashboard/ directory.
637/638 tests passing - maintain test hygiene. Bundle size ~601KB - monitor for Epic 3+.
Dashboard page loads and displays financial health within 2 seconds.
Interest calculations accurate to 2 decimal places (cent-level accuracy in ZAR).
